{{Conjecture|legends}}
The '''southern islands''' of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Yelsain/Legends|Yelsain]] were noted for their inclement weather, including [[Hurricane/Legends|hurricanes]], and dangerous wildlife. 
{{RPGseed}} 
A [[Zoologist/Legends|zoologist]] from [[Adarlon/Legends|Adarlon]] once contracted a [[Tramp freighter/Legends|tramp freighter]] crew to capture a rare creature from the southern islands.
